notes: rel_error = (predicted - measured) / measured; measured is the pooled capture median of the stage's GPU batch on GB10.

Pairs are deduplicated by assignment within a stage. seen_in_earlier_stage marks assignments measured in an earlier stage of the same trajectory (including v4/v6 stages for attn-small); authors saw that feedback, so those pairs are in-sample. unseen_pairs is the out-of-sample view.
Probes are chosen by the author, not sampled at random; ranking metrics are over the measured set only (model point, default, probes).
Configs that failed qualification have no latency and are counted, not paired.
